title: Preserve actor decisions and distinct concern identity rules
statement: The Work records Module shall preserve unresolved obligations and the attribution, scope and support of retained judgments while allowing explicit current-state replacement and dependency-safe compaction.

what.problem: A shaped update can erase unresolved work or silently broaden a judgment.
what.desired_outcome: Corrections remain possible with attributable current obligations and honest reliance gaps.

why.rationale: SR-042 separates structural validity from engineering judgment and preserves the facts needed for sound current decisions.

stakeholders: Engineers and agents supplying explicit command requests
Maintainers of MOD-011 and its Interface consumers

conditions: A candidate changes assessments, explanation values, findings, or blockers, or contains failed evidence, completed activity, or historical subject drift.

contexts: IF-003 validation against the coherent prior records and complete candidate for the same selected change.

how.approach: Compare only the preservation invariants applicable to the declared operation, retaining supplied decisions and separating recorded assertions from current mechanical observations.

how_much.scope: Current actor-supplied scope, subjects, narrative, status, issue identity and assessment support; no exhaustive history or mandatory immutable-origin snapshots.

acceptance_criteria: Actor-supplied status, subjects, applicability, provenance, explanation collection order and multiline meaning survive validation unchanged; neither a renderer nor validation creates another authoritative report.
Issue IDs remain stable while their accounts are retained. Omission never removes a finding; explicit disposition and dependency-free compaction follow the selected contract.
Assessment replacement preserves unresolved findings even when the new assessment is clean. V4 permits removal of disposed details only with explicit reason and no surviving reliance.

V3 retains immutable change-level blocker Origins. V4 uses attributable current issue accounts and dispositions without mandatory origin snapshots or complete history; no update silently rewrites a judgment still relied upon.

Adverse evidence, explicit invalidation and correction remain recordable. New accepted bases or successful final Verification require their declared support; invalid references and stale declared reads reject independently.
Actor labels, hashes and successful validation do not establish independence or engineering adequacy. Current support checks reconcile recorded dependencies, not unreported repository stability.

sources.basis: Derive this draft lower-level obligation from the containing SR at the selected command or operational-record responsibility boundary. Allocation and acceptance criteria are design claims for review, not implementation, requirement approval, or satisfaction evidence.

sources.basis: Preserve the applicable current public and stored-record guarantees at this accountable boundary. The named source retains exact schemas, operation tables, classifications, limits, and historical adoption obligations; this allocation neither replaces those details nor accepts REM authoring JSON as operational records.
Reconcile current-state replacement, unresolved issue preservation and selective retention; retain version-specific v3 behavior until adoption.

Reconcile the complete existing allocation with the selected current v2/v4 contract, preserving independent admission, coherent state, explicit scope and actor judgment. Prior version-specific sources retain their historical meaning.
